sentences.translation: Hũthĩra indo njeru na njũgĩ gũcitharithia nĩguo ndũkanangĩke na ũnyihanyihie ũgwati wa kũgwatwo nĩ mĩrimũ.
sentences.reference: Hũthĩra indo theru na njũgĩ gũceha kũgirĩrĩria gũthũkia na kũnyihia ũgwati wa mĩrimũHũthĩra indo theru na njũgĩ cia gũceha  nĩguo kũgirĩrĩria gũthũkia na kũnyihia ũgwati wa mĩrimũ

sentences.source: Space the seedbeds appropriately, leaving enough room for plant growth and management.
sentences.translation: Gĩthaka kĩa mbeũ kĩagĩrĩre, gĩkaiga handũ hega ha mĩmera gũkũra na kũmenyerera.
sentences.reference: Tiga mĩanya ya nathari ũrĩa kwagĩrĩire ũtigie mĩanya ya kũigana ya  mũmera gũkũra wega na kũhota kũmenyererwo

sentences.source: Harvesting intervals should be optimized to ensure high-quality tea leaves with the desired flavor profile.
sentences.translation: Ihinda rĩrĩa rĩagĩrĩire rĩa kũgetha rĩagĩrĩirũo gũkorũo rĩrĩ rĩega biũ nĩguo kũgĩe na mathangũ ma cai ma ũgima mwega marĩ na mũtaratara ũrĩa ũrenda wa mũtararĩko.
sentences.reference: Mahinda   matiganĩte ma  kũgetha cai   mabatiĩ kũigananio gũtigĩrĩra macani nĩ ma gĩkĩro kĩa igũru na  cai wĩna mũcamo ũrĩa urendekana

sentences.source: Tea contains antioxidants and other compounds that offer health benefits, boosting its popularity.
sentences.translation: Chai ĩkoragwo na antioxidants na indo ingĩ iria itũmaga ũgima wa mwĩrĩ ũkorũo ũrĩ mwega, na ũndũ ũcio ũgatũma ĩgĩe na ngumo mũno.
sentences.reference: Macani nĩ marĩ [cs] antioxidants [cs] na [cs] compounds [cs]  iria ikoragwo na ũguni harĩ  ũgima wa mwĩrĩ igatũma macani mendekane nĩ andũ

sentences.source: Conduct soil tests periodically to adjust fertilization practices.
sentences.translation: Gũthiĩ na mbere gũthima tĩĩri mahinda kwa mahinda nĩguo ũhote kũgarũrĩra njĩra iria ihũthagĩrũo gũitĩrĩria tĩĩri mũhu.
sentences.reference: Thima tĩri kaingĩ nĩgetha ũmenye ũrĩa  ũrĩhũthagĩra   bataraitha

sentences.source: Mimi ni ofisa wa ukulima wa ndengu
sentences.translation: Mimi ni ofisa wa ukulima wa ndengu
sentences.reference: Niĩ ndĩ obithaa wa ũrĩmi wa ndengũ

sentences.source: Tea is one of the most widely consumed beverages globally, providing both health benefits and economic value.
sentences.translation: Chai nĩ ĩmwe ya njoohi iria ihũthagĩrũo mũno thĩinĩ wa thĩ yothe, na nĩ ĩrehaga ũguni harĩ ũgima wa mwĩrĩ na ũguni wa kĩĩmbeca.
sentences.reference: Macani nĩ mamwe ma indo iria inyuagwo mũno thĩ yothe  kũheana ũgima na kũhe arĩmi mbeca

sentences.source: Set up pheromone traps to monitor coffee berry borer populations.
sentences.translation: Thondekage mĩtego ya pheromone nĩguo ũhote kũrora ng'ombe cia kahũwa.
sentences.reference: Gathĩka mĩtego ya [SC]pheromone[CS] nĩguo ũgirĩrĩrie ũingĩ wa [cs] coffee berry borer [cs]

sentences.source: Tea growing can be a long-term investment, with plants yielding crops for several decades.
sentences.translation: Ũrĩmi wa cai no ũkorũo ũrĩ wa ihinda iraya, na mĩmera ĩyo no ĩrute maciaro kwa ihinda rĩa mĩaka mĩingĩ.
sentences.reference: Ũrĩmi wa macani nĩ ũigithia wa ihinda ĩraihu tondũ cai nĩ ũgethagũo  kahinda ka  mĩaka mĩingĩ

sentences.source: The tea industry promotes tourism in regions known for tea production, attracting visitors to tea estates.
sentences.translation: Wĩra ũcio nĩ ũteithagia ũthii wa na mbere gĩcigo-inĩ kĩrĩa kĩmenyekaga nĩ ũndũ wa gũthondeka cai, na ũndũ ũcio nĩ ũgucagĩrĩria andũ gũceera mĩgũnda-inĩ ya cai.
sentences.reference: Ũrĩmi wa  macani nĩũteithagĩrĩria ũgendi  icigo inĩ iria ikũragia cai nĩ kũgucĩrĩria ageni mĩgũndainĩ ya macani

sentences.source: Test the soil pH to ensure it is slightly acidic, between 4.5 and 5.5, which is ideal for tea growth.
sentences.translation: Thuthuria pH ya tĩĩri nĩguo ũtigĩrĩre atĩ nĩ ĩkoragwo na ũũkĩ mũnini, gatagatĩ ka 4.5 na 5.5, ũrĩa ũkoragwo ũrĩ mwega harĩ gũkũra kwa cai.
sentences.reference: Thima [cs] pH [cs] ya tĩri nĩguo ũtigĩrĩre wĩna [cs] acidic [cs]  mũigana wa gatagatĩ ka inya gaturumo ithano nginya ithano gaturumo ithano ĩrĩa yagĩrĩire harĩ gũkũria gwa cai

sentences.source: Nursery beds should be 1 meter wide and 10-15 centimeters high.
sentences.translation: Mĩtĩ ya ciana cia ngoriai yagĩrĩirũo gũkorũo na ũraihu wa mita 1 na ũraihu wa sentimita 10-15.
sentences.reference: Nathari cia kũmerithia mbegũ ibatiĩ gũkorwo na wariĩ wa [cs] meter [cs]    imwe na ũraihu wa [cs] centimeters [cs] ikũmi nginya ikũmi na ithano

sentences.source: Regularly prune shade trees to allow sufficient light for coffee growth.
sentences.translation: Gũtemaga mĩtĩ ya kĩĩruru kaingĩ nĩguo kũgĩe na ũtheri wa kũigana nĩguo kahua gakũre.
sentences.reference: Ceha mĩtĩ ĩrĩa ĩrehaga kĩruru kaingĩ nĩgetha kahũa gakũre wega .

sentences.source: The tea industry generates foreign exchange for countries through exports.
sentences.translation: Wĩra wa gũthondeka chai nĩ ũheaga mabũrũri mbeca cia mabũrũri mangĩ kũgerera indo iria ithondekagwo mabũrũri-inĩ macio.
sentences.reference: Wendia wa macani nĩ ũrehagĩra bũrũri mbeca cia kuuma na nja

sentences.source: Maintain consistent soil moisture through regular watering, avoiding both drought and waterlogging.
sentences.translation: Gũtũũria ũrugarĩ mũgũnda-inĩ na njĩra ya gũitĩrĩria maaĩ kaingĩ, gwĩthema ng'aragu na kũingĩha maaĩ.
sentences.reference: Tigĩrĩra ũgunyu wa tĩri ni mũigananu na gũitĩrĩria maĩ kaingĩ ũgĩthemaga wagi  wa mbura na maĩ kũaraha

sentences.source: Intercropping with cover crops can reduce weed growth by shading the soil.
sentences.translation: Kũrĩma mĩgũnda ĩngĩ na mĩmera ĩngĩ no gũtũme nyeki ĩtige gũkũra na njĩra ya kũiga kĩĩruru mũgũnda-inĩ.
sentences.reference: Kũhandanĩria na mĩmera ĩngĩ ya kũhumbĩra tĩri nĩkũnyihagia gũkũra kwa ria na kũrehe  kĩruru

sentences.source: Prepare raised beds in the nursery to prevent waterlogging and improve drainage.
sentences.translation: Rũmbũiyaga itanda irĩ igũrũ nyũmba-inĩ ya ciana nĩguo itigakorũo na maaĩ maingĩ na nĩ ũndũ ũcio kũgĩe na njĩra njega ya kũruta maaĩ.
sentences.reference: Harĩria natharĩ nĩguo kũgirĩrĩria maĩ kũaraha na maikũrũke

sentences.source: The demand for organic and specialty teas has increased, providing opportunities for small-scale farmers.
sentences.translation: Mũbango wa kũnyua cai wa mũthemba mũna nĩ wongererekete na ũndũ ũcio nĩ ũhotithĩtie arĩmi anini kũgĩa na mbeca nyingĩ.
sentences.reference: Ũbataranu wa macani ma kĩmerera na ma mĩthemba ĩtiganĩte nĩũingĩhĩte na kuongerera mĩeke ya arĩmi anini.

sentences.source: Transplant tea seedlings when they are 6-12 months old and about 20-30 cm tall.
sentences.translation: Mĩmera ya cai nĩ ĩkũragwo hĩndĩ ĩrĩa ĩrĩ na mĩeri 6-12 na ĩgakorũo na ũraihu wa sentimita 20-30.
sentences.reference: Handa  mĩmera ya kahũa  mĩtaroinĩ ya mwaramo wa [cs[meter [cs]  igĩrĩ gaturumo ithano nginya [cs[meter [cs]  ithatũ.

sentences.source: Rabbits reproduce quickly, so plan for future housing needs.
sentences.translation: Mbũri ciũragaga na ihenya, kwoguo wĩcirie ũrĩa ũngĩenda nyũmba.
sentences.reference: Mbũkũ nĩ iciaranaga narua kwoguo no mũhaka ũcibangĩre nyũmba iria igaikara

sentences.source: Create contour lines on sloped land to prevent soil erosion and improve water retention.
sentences.translation: Gũthondekithia mĩtaratara ya kũndũ kũrĩa kũhumbĩrĩte nĩguo kũgĩe na rĩera rĩega na kũgĩe na ũhoti mwega wa kũiga maaĩ.
sentences.reference: Thondeka mĩtaro mũgũnda wĩna mũikũrũko nĩguo kũiga maĩ  na kũgirĩrĩria tĩri gũtwaro.

sentences.source: Intercrop coffee with legumes to fix nitrogen and improve soil fertility.
sentences.translation: Gũtema kahũa na mĩmera ya ngigĩ nĩguo kũgĩe na nitrogen na kũgaacĩrithia mũgũnda.
sentences.reference: Handanĩrĩa kahũa na mboco  nĩguo gwĩkĩra [cs] nitrogen [cs] na kũgacĩria ũnoru wa mũgũnda

sentences.source: Water the nursery bed thoroughly before sowing the seeds to ensure adequate moisture levels.
sentences.translation: Nĩguo mbegũ ikorũo na ũrugarĩ ũrĩa ũrabatarania, igayagĩrũo maaĩ wega mbere ya kũhanda.
sentences.reference: Itĩrĩria natharĩ maĩ wega mbere ya kũhura mbegũ nĩgetha ũtigĩrĩre ũgunyu  nĩ mũiganu

sentences.source: Use shade nets or natural shading to protect young tea seedlings from excessive sunlight.
sentences.translation: Hũthĩra neti cia kĩĩruru kana ithima cia kĩĩruru cia ndũire kũgitĩra tũthũngũri tũrĩa tũnini twa cai kuumana na ũtheri mũingĩ wa riũa.
sentences.reference: Hũthĩra neti cia kĩruru kana kĩruru kĩa mĩtĩ  kũgitĩra mĩcai kuumana na riũa na ũtheri mũkĩru

sentences.source: Water the seedlings immediately after transplanting to reduce transplant shock.
sentences.translation: Thambia mbegũ na ihenya thutha wa gũcithondeka nĩguo ũnyihanyihie mũrimũ ũcio.
sentences.reference: Wahanda o ũguo  itĩrĩria mĩmera ĩyo maĩ nĩgetha ũgirĩrĩrie kũhoha.

sentences.source: Tea cultivation can improve soil quality through organic farming practices.
sentences.translation: Kũrĩma chai no gũtũme mũgũnda ũkorũo ũrĩ mwega kũgerera ũrĩmi wa indo iria ithondeketwo na njĩra ya ndũire.
sentences.reference: Ũrimi wa macani nĩ wongagĩrĩra ũnoru wa tĩri nĩ ũndũ wa gũĩkĩrũo thumu

sentences.source: Sow the tea seeds in rows, spacing them 10-15 cm apart for optimal growth.
sentences.translation: Handa mbegũ cia cai rũrenda-inĩ, ũgaciikĩria na ũraihu wa sentimita 10 nginya 15 nĩguo ikũre wega.
sentences.reference: Hura  mbegũ cia macani mĩtaroinĩ ũmĩtaganĩtie [cs] centimeter [cs] ikũmi nginya ikũmi na ithano nĩgetha ikũre wega.

sentences.source: You can use varieties such as coffee arabica, bourbon coffee, caturra and Geisha among others
sentences.translation: No ũhũthĩre mĩthemba ta cai arabica, cai bourbon, caturra na Geisha hamwe na ingĩ
sentences.reference: No ũhũthĩre mĩthemba ta [cs] coffee arabica, [cs]bourbon coffee[cs], [cs] caturra na [cs] Geisha [cs]  hamwe na mĩthemba ĩrĩa  ĩngĩ

sentences.source: Apply organic manure or compost to enhance soil fertility before planting seeds.
sentences.translation: Mbere ya kũhanda mbegũ, hũthagĩra mũtararĩko kana mũtararĩko wa indo iria ithondeketwo gũteithia mũgũnda ũiyũre irio.
sentences.reference: Mbere ya kũhanda mbegũ itĩrĩria thumu kana  mahuti matukanĩire irimainĩ  nĩguo  kũgacĩria ũnoru wa tĩri

sentences.source: Ensure proper drainage systems are in place to prevent waterlogging during heavy rains.
sentences.translation: Gũtigĩrĩra atĩ kũrĩ na mĩtaratara mĩiganu ya gũthambia maaĩ nĩgetha kũgĩe na ũgitĩri wa maaĩ hĩndĩ ya mbura nene.
sentences.reference: Tigĩrĩra wĩna mĩtaro ya gũikũrũkia  maĩ   nĩgetha maĩ matikarahe mbura nyingĩ yaura

sentences.source: Cover the seeds lightly with soil and mulch to retain moisture and promote germination.
sentences.translation: Mĩmera ĩyo ĩhumbĩtwo na tĩĩri na mũtararĩko nĩguo ĩikare ĩrĩ na ũrugarĩ na ĩgaacĩre.
sentences.reference: Humbĩra mbegũ na tĩri na mahuti  nĩgetha ũige ũgunyu wa gũteithĩrĩria mbegũ kũmera

sentences.source: Apply fertilizers at the recommended rates, avoiding over-application that can harm plants.
sentences.translation: Hũthĩra mũbango ũrĩa wagĩrĩire, no wĩtheme kũhũthĩra mũbango mũingĩ ũrĩa ũngĩthũkia mĩmera.
sentences.reference: Ĩkĩra bataraitha na ikĩro nyendekithie ũtagũĩkĩra nyingi ĩrĩa ingĩthũkia mĩmera.

sentences.source: Prepare terraces on steep slopes to create flat planting areas and reduce runoff.
sentences.translation: Handaga ithaka kũndũ kũrĩa kũrũgĩte nĩguo ũhote kũhanda na njĩra ĩtarĩ njũru.
sentences.reference: Thondeka benji kũndũ gũikũrũku nĩguo ũkorwo na kũndũ kwaraganu gwa kũrima na kũnyihia kĩguũ

sentences.source: Plant during the rainy season or irrigate the field before planting to ensure soil moisture.
sentences.translation: Ũrĩmaga hĩndĩ ya mbura kana ũkarigithia mũgũnda mbere ya kũhanda nĩguo ũtigĩrĩre atĩ mũgũnda nĩ ũkoragwo na ũrugarĩ.
sentences.reference: Handa hĩndĩ ya kĩmera kĩa  mbura kana ũitĩrĩrie maĩ mbere ya kũhanda nĩgetha ũtigĩrĩre nĩ kũgunyu.

sentences.source: Ensure proper drainage in the nursery bed to prevent waterlogging.
sentences.translation: Gũthiĩ na mbere kũruta maaĩ na njĩra ĩrĩa yagĩrĩire mũgũnda-inĩ ũcio wa kũiga twana tũnini nĩguo tũtikagĩe na maaĩ maingĩ.
sentences.reference: Tigĩrĩra nathari nĩĩratĩrĩrio maĩ  marĩa maiganĩte nĩgetha ũgitĩre kũaraha kwa maĩ.

sentences.source: Conduct soil tests to determine nutrient levels and pH, adjusting them as necessary.
sentences.translation: Gũthuthuria mũgũnda nĩguo ũmenye mũigana wa irio na pH, ũcoke ũcenjie ũrĩa kũrabatarania.
sentences.reference: Thima tĩri nĩgetha ũmenye kana wĩna hinya mwagĩrĩru na [pH] njega nĩgetha ucigananie ũrĩa kwagĩrĩire

sentences.source: Prepare the field by plowing and leveling before transplanting coffee seedlings.
sentences.translation: Wĩthondekere mũgũnda ũcio na njĩra ya kũrĩma na kũrũnga mbere ya gũcitharũria mbegũ cia kahua.
sentences.reference: Harĩria mũgũnda na kũrĩma na kũiganania mbere ya kũhanda mĩmera ya kahũa werũ

sentences.source: Prune the plants to encourage bushy growth and improve air circulation.
sentences.translation: Gũtema mĩmera nĩ gũteithagia mĩmera ĩgĩe na mĩmera mĩingĩ na kũrehe rĩera rĩega.
sentences.reference: Ceha mĩmera nĩgetha ĩgĩe na mahuti maingĩ na kũagagĩria ũtambia wa rĩera.

sentences.source: Tea plants can be intercropped with other crops, providing farmers with additional income.
sentences.translation: Mĩtĩ ya cai no ĩkũragwo hamwe na mĩmera ĩngĩ, na ũndũ ũcio ũgatũma arĩmi makorũo na mbeca nyingĩ.
sentences.reference: Cai  no uhandanĩrio na mĩthemba ĩngĩ ya irio nĩguo mũrĩmi  eongerere umithio

sentences.source: Avoid feeding rabbits foods high in sugar or starch.
sentences.translation: Wĩtheme kũhe thenge irio irĩ na cukari mũingĩ kana cumbĩ mũingĩ.
sentences.reference: Wĩtheme kũhe mbũkũ irio ciina cukari  na wanga mũingĩ

sentences.source: Choose healthy, disease-free seedlings or cuttings for planting in the prepared field.
sentences.translation: Thuura mĩmera ĩrĩ na ũgima mwega wa mwĩrĩ na ĩtarĩ na mĩrimũ nĩguo ũmĩhande mũgũnda-inĩ ũrĩa ũhaarĩirio.
sentences.reference: Thura mĩmera ĩtarĩ na mĩrimu kana itihĩtio ya kũhanda mũgũndainĩ mũharĩrie

sentences.source: Water the transplanted seedlings immediately to help them establish in the new environment.
sentences.translation: Nĩ ũndũ wa gũteithĩrĩria mĩmera ĩyo kũgĩa na ũrata na mũgũnda ũcio mwerũ, no ĩnyue maĩ na ihenya.
sentences.reference: Itĩrĩria mĩmera ĩyo  yahandwo maĩ o rĩo nĩgetha ĩgũate hau yahandwo

sentences.source: Protect the newly transplanted seedlings from strong winds or excessive sunlight by providing shade.
sentences.translation: Kũgitĩra mĩmera ĩrĩa ĩrarutwo kuuma kũrĩ rũhuho rũnene kana ũtheri mũingĩ wa riũa na njĩra ya kũmĩhe kĩĩruru.
sentences.reference: Gitĩra mĩmera mĩeru  ĩyo yahandwo kuumana na rũhuho na riũa ikĩru na gũĩkĩra  kĩruru.

sentences.source: Regular pruning promotes new leaf production, which is crucial for high tea yields.
sentences.translation: Gũtema mathangũ kaingĩ nĩ gũteithagia gũthondeka mathangũ merũ, na ũndũ ũcio nĩ wa bata mũno harĩ kũgĩa na magetha maingĩ.
sentences.reference: Gũceha kaingĩ nĩgũteithagia kũruta mathangũ merũ marĩa mateithagia kũruta  maciaro maingĩ.

sentences.source: Pruning helps improve air circulation within the plant canopy, reducing the risk of disease.
sentences.translation: Gũtema nĩ gũteithagia kũrehe rĩera rĩega mũgũnda-inĩ, ũndũ ũrĩa ũnyihanyihia ũgwati wa mĩrimũ.
sentences.reference: Gũceha nĩ gũteithagia rĩera gũtamba wega igũrũ wa mĩmera na kũnyihia ũgwati wa mĩrimũ

sentences.source: Handpick larger pests like caterpillars to reduce infestation.
sentences.translation: Gũthura tũnyamũ tũngĩ tũnene ta tũng'aurũ na moko nĩguo tũnyihanyihie mũigana wa tũnyamũ tũu.
sentences.reference: Ruta tũtambĩ tũnene ta ĩgunyu na moko nĩgetha ũnyihie mĩrimũ.

sentences.source: Picked flowers should be put into well-ventilated baskets to reduce fermentation.
sentences.translation: Mĩmera ĩrĩa yacokagĩrio nĩ yagĩrĩirũo kũigwo ithandũkũ-inĩ irĩ na rĩera rĩega nĩguo ĩtigathũke mũno.
sentences.reference: Mahũa marĩa matuĩtwo mabatiĩ kũigwo ikabu-inĩ  ikũrehe  rĩera wega nĩgetha kũnyihia kũgagata.

sentences.source: Mulch around the base of the plants to retain moisture and suppress weed growth.
sentences.translation: Thondekagĩria mĩmera rungu rwa tĩĩri nĩguo ĩikare ĩrĩ na ũrugarĩ na ĩgirĩrĩrie nyeki ĩtikũre.
sentences.reference: Humbĩra gĩtinainĩ  kĩa mũmera nĩguo ũige ũgunyu na  ũhite kũmera kwa ria.

sentences.source: Fill the hole with soil, gently firming it around the roots to remove air pockets.
sentences.translation: Ũcoke ũiyũrie irima rĩu na tĩĩri, ũcithondeke wega mĩri-inĩ nĩguo ũhote kweheria tũcunjĩ twa rĩera.
sentences.reference: Iyũria irima na tĩri na ũkindĩre kahora mĩriinĩ  nĩgetha weherie tũmĩanya twa rĩera.

sentences.source: Consider supplementing their diet with mineral blocks.
sentences.translation: Wĩcirie ũhoro wa kũmateithĩrĩria na indo ingĩ.
sentences.reference: Wĩcirie kũongerera [cs] mineral blocks [cs[ irio-inĩ

sentences.source: Inspect stored coffee beans periodically for signs of pests or mold.
sentences.translation: Rora mbegũ cia kahũwa iria ciigĩtwo kaingĩ wone kana nĩ ikoragwo na mĩrimũ mĩũru kana ngogoyo.
sentences.reference: Thũrima mbegũ cia kahũa iria cigĩtwo thitoo   mahinda kwa mahinda nĩgetha wone kana harĩ na tũtambi kana mbaa.

sentences.source: Replace any weak or damaged plants with new seedlings to ensure uniform growth.
sentences.translation: Mĩmera ĩrĩa ĩtarĩ mĩgima kana ĩrĩ na mahĩtia ĩcokagĩrio mĩmera ĩngĩ mĩerũ nĩguo ĩikare ĩgĩkũra wega.
sentences.reference: Kũrania mĩmera  ĩrĩa mĩhohu na mĩtihie na mĩmera mĩeru nĩguo gũtigĩrĩra nĩrakũra ĩiganaine.

sentences.source: Water the nursery bed regularly to keep the soil moist.
sentences.translation: Thikagĩrĩria mũgũnda ũcio kaingĩ nĩguo ũikare ũrĩ na maĩ.
sentences.reference: Itĩrĩria natharĩ maĩ kahinda gwa kahinda nĩgetha ũige  tĩri wĩna ũgunyu mũiganu.

sentences.source: Transplant seedlings to the field when they have 4-6 true leaves.
sentences.translation: Handaga mĩmera mĩerũ mũgũnda-inĩ rĩrĩa ĩrĩ na mathangũ 4-6.
sentences.reference: Handa mĩmera mũgũnda-inĩ yagĩa mathangũ makĩru mana nginya matandatũ.

sentences.source: Gently remove the seedlings from the nursery, taking care not to damage the roots.
sentences.translation: Ũcoke ũrute mĩmera ĩyo na njĩra ya ũcekeceke, wĩmenyerere ndũkanathũkie mĩri.
sentences.reference: Kũra mĩmera kuuma natharĩ-inĩ na ũmenyerere ndũgathũkie mĩri.

sentences.source: Place the seedling in the hole, ensuring the root collar is level with the soil surface.
sentences.translation: Reke mbegũ ĩikare irima-inĩ, ĩcoke ĩtigĩrĩre atĩ mĩri ya mbegũ ĩyo ĩikaraga thĩ.
sentences.reference: Handa mũmera irima-inĩ na ũtigĩrĩre mĩri nĩ ihumbĩrĩtwo nĩ tĩri.

sentences.source: Choose a cloudy or rainy day for transplanting to minimize stress on the seedlings.
sentences.translation: Thuura mũthenya ũrĩ na matu kana wa mbura nĩguo ũhũthie mĩmera ĩyo.
sentences.reference: Thuura  mũthenya wĩna matu kana mbura wa kũhanda mĩmera  nĩguo ĩgwate wega.

sentences.source: Apply organic manure or compost to each hole before transplanting the seedlings.
sentences.translation: Mbere ya gũcokia mĩmera ĩyo mũgũnda-inĩ, hũthagĩra mũtararĩko kana mũtararĩko wa indo iria ithondeketwo mũgũnda-inĩ.
sentences.reference: Ĩkĩra irima o irima thumu kana  mahuti matukanĩirio irima-inĩ ũtanahanda mĩmera.

sentences.source: Add compost or organic manure to the planting hole before transplanting.
sentences.translation: Mbere ya kũiga mũtararĩko, ongerera mũtararĩko kana mũtararĩko wa indo iria ithondeketwo mũgũnda-inĩ ũcio wa kũhanda.
sentences.reference: Ongerera  mahuti mahumbĩrĩtwo kana thumu irima-inĩ ũtanahanda mũmera.

sentences.source: Use nitrogen-based fertilizers to promote leafy growth in tea plants.
sentences.translation: Hũthĩra irio iria ikoragwo na nitrogen nĩguo mĩmera ya cai ĩgĩe na mathangũ.
sentences.reference: Hũthira bataraitha ĩna [cs] nitrogen [cs]   nĩ getha  ĩkũrie mathangũ maingĩ mĩmera-inĩ ya macani

sentences.source: Prepare the main field by tilling and leveling the soil, ensuring proper drainage.
sentences.translation: Kũhaarĩria mũgũnda ũrĩa mũnene na njĩra ya kũhanda na kũrũgamia tĩri, na kũiga maaĩ na njĩra njega.
sentences.reference: Harĩria mũgũnda na kũrĩma na kũiganania tĩri na kũenja mĩtaro

sentences.source: Prune tea plants annually to maintain their shape and encourage bushy growth.
sentences.translation: Gũtemaga mĩmera ya cai o mwaka nĩguo ĩtũũrie mũhianĩre wayo na ĩgĩe na mĩmera mĩingĩ.
sentences.reference: Ceha macani o mwaka nĩguo maige mũhanĩre wamo na magacĩrithie kũmera mathangũ

sentences.source: Regularly prune coffee plants to maintain proper shape and remove dead branches.
sentences.translation: Gũtemaga mĩmera ya kahũa kaingĩ nĩgetha ĩikare ĩrĩ na mũhianĩre ũrĩa wagĩrĩire na kweheria honge iria ciũrĩte.
sentences.reference: Ceha kahũa o hingo nĩguo ĩikare na mũhanĩre mwega na weherie honge nyũmũ

sentences.source: Soil type and drainage strongly affect a sites suitability for pyrethrum growing
sentences.translation: Mũthemba wa tĩĩri na mũtararĩko wa maaĩ nĩ ũhutagia mũno ũigananĩru wa gĩcigo kĩa mũtararĩko wa pyrethrum
sentences.reference: Mũthemba wa tĩri na ũhoti wa tĩri kũnywa maĩ nĩundu ũngĩ ũroragwo ũkũriainĩ wa Mahũa ma mbeniko

sentences.source: Keep track of market trends to adjust your rabbit meat prices accordingly.
sentences.translation: Rũmagĩrĩra maũndũ marĩa marekĩka thoko-inĩ nĩguo ũhote kũgarũrĩra thogora wa nyama ya mbogo waku kũringana na maũndũ macio.
sentences.reference: Ikara ũkimenyaga ũrĩa thoko ĩikarĩte nĩgetha ũcenjĩe thogora wa kũendia nyama cia mbũkũ ũria kwagĩrĩire

sentences.source: After pruning, apply fertilizers to support the regrowth of leaves and branches.
sentences.translation: Thutha wa kũmenyeria, ũhũthagĩra mboco nĩguo mathangũ na honge ciaku ciambĩrĩrie gũkũra rĩngĩ.
sentences.reference: Thutha wa gũceha, ĩkĩra thumu nĩguo mathangũ na honge ikũre rĩngĩ

sentences.source: Regular plucking of tea leaves encourages new growth and prevents the plants from becoming overgrown.
sentences.translation: Gũtema mathangũ ma cai kaingĩ nĩ gũteithagia mĩmera kũgĩa na mbeũ njerũ na gũgĩtũma ĩtikũre mũno.
sentences.reference: Gũtua macani mahinda kwa mahinda nĩ gũtigagĩrĩra nimakũra rĩngĩ na mĩmera ndĩra neneha mũno

sentences.source: Protect coffee plants from strong winds by planting windbreaks around the farm.
sentences.translation: Kũgitĩra mĩmera ya kahua kuumana na rũhuho rũnene na njĩra ya kũhanda indo cia kũgirĩrĩria rũhuho mĩena yothe ya mũgũnda.
sentences.reference: Gitagĩrĩra  mĩmera ya kahũa kuma rũhuho rũingĩ na kũhanda mĩti ya kũnyihia rũhuho gũthiũrũrũkĩria mũgũnda

sentences.source: Irrigate coffee plants during dry spells to maintain consistent growth.
sentences.translation: Hũthĩra maaĩ mĩmera-inĩ ya kahũa hĩndĩ ya ng'aragu nĩguo ĩthiĩ na mbere gũkũra.
sentences.reference: Taatagĩria kahũa maĩ kĩmera kĩa riũa nĩgetha ĩkũre hĩndĩ ciothe

sentences.source: Apply organic fertilizer in the nursery bed for healthy seedling growth.
sentences.translation: Hũthĩra maguta ma indo iria ithondeketwo mũgũnda-inĩ wa kũiga mbeũ cia kũhanda nĩguo mbeũ cia kũhanda ikũre wega.
sentences.reference: Ĩkĩra thumu ikũrĩrio nĩguo mĩmera ĩkũre wega

sentences.source: Apply fertilizers after soil tests to address specific nutrient deficiencies.
sentences.translation: Mĩmera ĩrĩa ĩhũthagĩrũo gũthima mũgũnda no ĩkorũo ĩrĩ mĩhũthũ gũtaũkĩrũo nĩ ũrĩa ĩhũthagĩrũo.
sentences.reference: Ĩkĩra thumu thutha wa gũthima tĩri nigetha kumenyeke [cs]nutrient[cs] ĩria ĩraga

sentences.source: Promote the nutritional benefits of rabbit meat to attract health-conscious consumers.
sentences.translation: Kũgathĩrĩria ũguni wa irio iria ciumanaga na nyama ya mbũri nĩguo andũ arĩa marũmbũyagia ũgima wa mwĩrĩ metĩkĩre irio icio.
sentences.reference: Tambia ndũmĩrĩri cia  ũguni  wa kũrĩa  nyama ya mbũkũ  nĩgetha ũgucĩrĩrie agũri arĩa mamenyagĩrĩra ũgima wao wa mwĩrĩ.

sentences.source: Prune during the dormant season to minimize stress on the plants.
sentences.translation: Gũtema mĩmera hĩndĩ ĩrĩa ĩtarĩ na mĩmera nĩgetha ĩtikagĩe na mĩnoga mĩingĩ.
sentences.reference: Ceha rĩrĩa gũtarĩ na ũrĩmi mũingĩ  nĩgetha  kũnyihia  kũhinyĩrĩrĩka kwa mĩmera.

sentences.source: Continue to weed the field regularly to reduce competition for nutrients and water.
sentences.translation: Thiĩ na mbere kweheria thawani mũgũnda-inĩ kaingĩ nĩguo ũnyihanyihie ũgucania wa irio na maĩ.
sentences.reference: Thiĩ na mbere na kũrĩmĩra  ria nĩgetha ũnyihie mũhĩtahĩtano wa  irio na maĩ harĩ  mĩmera.

sentences.source: Practice contour planting on slopes to prevent soil erosion in coffee fields.
sentences.translation: Hũthĩra njĩra ya kũhanda mĩgũnda-inĩ ya kahũwa nĩguo ũgirĩrĩrie mũthanga ndũkoore mĩgũnda-inĩ ya kahũwa.
sentences.reference: Menyera kũhanda benji mĩikũrũko-inĩ nĩgetha  kũgirĩrĩa tĩri gũtuĩka mĩgũnda-inĩ ya kahũa.

sentences.source: Dig planting holes 60 centimeters deep and wide for each coffee plant.
sentences.translation: Rora ithima cia kũhanda cia ũraihu na ũraihu wa sentimita 60 harĩ o mũtĩ wa kahua.
sentences.reference: Enja marima marĩ na ũriku  na wariĩ wa [cs] centimeters [cs] mĩrongo ĩtandatũ harĩ o mũmera wa kahũa.

sentences.source: Sow coffee seeds 1-2 centimeters deep in the nursery bed.
sentences.translation: Handa mbegũ cia kahũa na ũritũ wa santimetero 1 nginya 2.
sentences.reference: Hura mbegũ cia kahũa na ũriku-inĩ  wa [cs] centimeters [cs] ĩmwe nginya igĩrĩ natharĩ-inĩ.

sentences.source: Maintain proper spacing between coffee plants to reduce pest outbreaks.
sentences.translation: Gũthiĩ na mbere kũiga kamwanya gatagĩrĩire gatagatĩ ka mĩmera ya kahũa nĩguo ũhote kũniina mĩrimũ ĩrĩa ĩrehaga mĩrimũ mĩũru.
sentences.reference: Tigithũkania mĩmera ya kahũa wega nĩguo kũnyihia mũtuthũko wa tũtambi

sentences.source: Avoid harvesting immature or overripe coffee cherries to maintain uniformity.
sentences.translation: Gwĩthema kũgetha maciaro ma kahua marĩa mataakinyĩte hĩndĩ ya kũhĩa kana marĩa makinyĩte hĩndĩ ya kũhĩa mũno nĩgetha magĩe na mũhianĩre ũmwe.
sentences.reference: Wĩtheme kũgetha mbũni ĩtarĩ ngũrũ kana  iria ciĩruite mũno nĩgetha ũkorwo na ũigananu wa  o igetha.

sentences.source: Apply neem oil to control coffee berry borer infestation.
sentences.translation: Hũthĩra maguta ma neem nĩguo ũhote kwĩgirĩrĩria mũrimũ wa coffee berry borer.
sentences.reference: Itĩrĩria maguta ma  [cs] neem [cs] nĩgetha  ũgirĩrĩe kahũa kũgũmĩrwo nĩ gathegethi  ka mbũni  ya kahũa.

sentences.source: Prepare the coffee nursery bed in a shaded area with well-drained soil.
sentences.translation: Ĩhaarĩrie mũgũnda wa kũhanda kahũa handũ harĩ na kĩĩruru na mũgũnda ũtarĩ na maaĩ.
sentences.reference: Harĩrĩa natharĩ ya kahũa handũ harĩ na kĩruru na tĩri wĩna ũikũrũkia  mwega wa maĩ.

sentences.source: Always ensure your rabbit meat complies with local food safety regulations.
sentences.translation: Hingo ciothe geria nyama yaku ya mbũri ĩrũmĩrĩre mawatho ma kũrĩa ũikaraga megiĩ ũgitĩri wa irio.
sentences.reference: Hĩndĩ ciothe tigĩrĩra nyama yaku ya mbũkũ  nĩkinyĩtie gĩkĩro kĩa wega wa irio kĩrĩa gĩkĩrĩtwo nĩ watho.

sentences.source: Sort and grade coffee cherries immediately after harvesting.
sentences.translation: Gũthondeka na gũthondeka kahũa ka cherry thutha wa kũgethwo.
sentences.reference: Thura na ũgayanie  mbuni  o warĩkia kũgetha.

sentences.source: Mulch around coffee plants to conserve soil moisture and suppress weeds.
sentences.translation: Wĩthare mĩgũnda-inĩ ya kahũa nĩguo ĩtũũre ĩrĩ na ũrugarĩ na ĩgirĩrĩrie magogo.
sentences.reference: Humbĩra itina cia kahũa na mahuti nĩgetha kũiga ũgunyu wa tĩri na kũgirĩrĩria ria.

sentences.source: Inspect coffee plants regularly for signs of pest damage.
sentences.translation: Thuthuragia mĩmera ya kahũa kaingĩ nĩgetha wone kana nĩ kũrĩ mĩrimũ mĩũru.
sentences.reference: Barania  mĩmera ya kahũa kaingi  ũrore  marũri ma ũthũkangia wa tũtambĩ.

sentences.source: Use drip irrigation to conserve water and deliver nutrients efficiently.
sentences.translation: Hũthĩra njĩra ya gũitĩrĩria maaĩ maaĩ-inĩ nĩguo ũhote kũiga maaĩ na irio wega.
sentences.reference: Hũthĩra njĩra ya gũtatia maĩ nĩgetha kũnyihia ũhũthĩri mũingĩ wa maĩ na gũkinyia hinya na njĩra njega.

sentences.source: Provide clean bedding in the rabbit house, such as straw or wood shavings.
sentences.translation: Hũthĩra indo njega cia ũrĩrĩ nyũmba-inĩ ya thenge, ta rũũa kana mĩgogo ya mbaũ.
sentences.reference: Harĩria handũ hatheru ha gũkoma nyũmba-inĩ ya mbũkũ  ũkĩhũthĩra  rũũa  rwa mwere , rũũa  rwa ngano kana mura.

sentences.source: Avoid over-irrigation to prevent fungal infections in coffee plants.
sentences.translation: Gwĩthema gũitĩrĩria cai mũno nĩ getha ũgirĩrĩrie mĩrimũ ya mahũngũ mĩmera-inĩ ya kahũa.
sentences.reference: Wĩtheme gũitĩrĩria maĩ maingĩ  mũno nĩgetha kũgirĩrĩria mĩmera ya kahaũa kũgũmĩrwo nĩ mĩrimũ ya [cs] fungal [cs].

sentences.source: Remove suckers and water shoots to maintain a single stem in coffee plants.
sentences.translation: Thengia ĩyo, nĩ ũkuona atĩ nĩ ũhũthagĩra njĩra njega kũruta kahũa ka mũthemba ũcio.
sentences.reference: Eheria tũthuna na tũthethũka nĩgetha  ngoro ya mĩtĩ ya kahũa ĩkorwo ĩrĩ o ĩmwe.

sentences.source: Introduce natural predators like ants to control coffee pests biologically.
sentences.translation: Kũingĩria indo cia ndũire ta thumu kũgirĩrĩria mĩrimũ ya kahũa na njĩra ya kĩĩmwĩrĩ.
sentences.reference: No ũrehe  tũtambi tũria tũriaga tũnyamũ  tũnini ta thuraku twa kũgirĩrĩria mĩrimũ [cs] biologically [cs]

sentences.source: Apply organic or chemical fertilizers twice a year for optimal coffee growth.
sentences.translation: Nĩguo kahũa gakũre wega, no ũhũthagĩre maguta ma indo iria ithondeketwo tene kana ma indo cia ndũire maita merĩ o mwaka.
sentences.reference: Itĩrĩria bataraitha cia kĩmerera na cia [cs] chemical [cs]  maita merĩ mwaka nĩguo kahũa gakũre wega.

sentences.source: Grade coffee beans based on size, weight, and quality.
sentences.translation: Gũthondeka kahua kũringana na ũritũ, ũritũ, na ũgima wako.
sentences.reference: Thuraia  mbegũ cia kahũa kumana na ũigana, ũritũ na wagĩrĩru.

sentences.source: Dry coffee beans on raised beds or patios to reduce moisture content.
sentences.translation: Gũthambia mbegũ cia kahua na njĩra ya gũciiga mathangũ-inĩ ma igũrũ kana mathangũ-inĩ ma nja nĩguo itikagĩe na ũrugarĩ mũingĩ.
sentences.reference: Ũmithia mbuni cia kahũa kĩrĩrĩ-inĩ kana handũ haraganu  nĩgetha kũnyihia gĩkĩro kĩa ũgunyu

sentences.source: Mulch with coffee husks to recycle nutrients back into the soil.
sentences.translation: Hũthĩra mathangũ ma kahũa gũcokia irio mũgũnda-inĩ.
sentences.reference: Humbĩra na makoni  ma kahũa nĩgetha ũcokie irio cia ũkũria tĩri-inĩ.

sentences.source: Irrigate coffee plants during dry spells to maintain consistent growth.
sentences.translation: Hũthĩra maaĩ mĩmera-inĩ ya kahũa hĩndĩ ya ng'aragu nĩguo ĩthiĩ na mbere gũkũra.
sentences.reference: Itĩrĩria mĩmera ya kahũa maĩ hĩndĩ ya riũa  nĩgetha ĩkure wega

sentences.source: Control pests by maintaining cleanliness and using natural repellents.
sentences.translation: Kũniina tũnyamũ tũrĩa tũrehaga mĩrimũ na njĩra ya gũikaraga tũrĩ atheru na kũhũthĩra indo cia kũgirĩrĩria mĩrimũ.
sentences.reference: Girĩgĩrĩria  tũtambĩ  na njĩra  ya  kũiga ũtheru na gũtũmĩra indo cia kĩmerera cia gũtũingata.

sentences.source: Store dried coffee beans in moisture-proof bags to prevent spoilage.
sentences.translation: Gũtũũria mbeũ cia kahũwa ithondeketwo na njĩra ya kũiga mĩkebe-inĩ ĩtarĩ na ũrugarĩ nĩguo itikanathũke.
sentences.reference: Iga mbũni ĩrĩkĩtie kũniara mĩhukoinĩ ĩtangĩingĩria ũgunyu kũgirĩrĩria  ndĩgathũke

sentences.source: Rabbit farming starts with constructing a proper house for your rabbits.
sentences.translation: Kũrĩma thenge kwambĩrĩria na gwaka nyũmba njega ya thenge ciaku.
sentences.reference: Ũrĩmi wa mbũkũ wambagĩrĩria na gũciakĩra nyũmba njega.

sentences.source: Avoid excessive nitrogen application, which can increase pest and disease susceptibility.
sentences.translation: Wĩtheme kũhũthĩra nitrogen mũno, tondũ ũndũ ũcio no ũtũme ũgwati wa nyamũ na mĩrimũ wongerereke.
sentences.reference: Wĩtheme gwĩkĩra [cs] nitrogen [cs] makĩria tondũ noyongerere ũhũthũ wa kũgũmĩrwo nĩ tũtambi na mĩrimũ.

sentences.source: Feed rabbits a balanced diet to ensure healthy growth.
sentences.translation: Mũheaga irio iria ciagĩrĩire nĩguo akũre na ũgima mwega wa mwĩrĩ.
sentences.reference: He mbũkũ irio  ginyanĩrĩrũ nĩgetha ikũre wega.

sentences.source: Handpick ripe coffee cherries during the harvest season.
sentences.translation: Gũthura na moko maciaro ma kahũa hĩndĩ ya magetha.
sentences.reference: Tua na moko mbũni  njĩru  hĩndĩ ya kũgetha.

sentences.source: Common pests in rabbit farming include mites, fleas, and ticks.
sentences.translation: Mĩrimũ ĩrĩa ĩtũmagĩrũo mũno kũrĩithia thenge nĩ ta ngigĩ, ngigĩ, na ngigĩ.
sentences.reference: Tũtambi tũrĩa tũgũmagĩra ũrĩmi wa mbũku nĩ hamwe na  mũthũa, thuya na ngũha.

sentences.source: Winter wheat is planted in the fall and can survive freezing temperatures.
sentences.translation: Ngano ya hĩndĩ ya heho ĩhandwo hĩndĩ ya ũrugarĩ na no ĩtũũre o na kũrĩ na heho mũno.
sentences.reference: Ngano ya hĩndĩ ya heho ĩhandagwo heho yanyihanyiha  na noyage gũtorio  nĩ heho ĩna mbarafu.

sentences.source: Ensure the meat remains at a safe temperature during transport.
sentences.translation: Tigagĩrĩra atĩ nyama nĩ igũtũũra ĩrĩ na ũrugarĩ ũrĩa wagĩrĩire hĩndĩ ĩrĩa ĩratwarwo.
sentences.reference: Tĩgĩrĩra nyama nĩyaigwo na ũrugarĩ ũrĩa wagĩrĩire  igĩtwarwo thoko.

sentences.source: Plant shade trees in the coffee field to protect plants from direct sunlight.
sentences.translation: Mũrĩmĩrie mĩtĩ ya kũhe kĩĩruru mĩgũnda-inĩ ya kahũa nĩguo ĩmĩgitĩre kuumana na ũtheri wa riũa.
sentences.reference: Handa mĩtĩ ya  kũrehe kĩruru mũgũndainĩ wa kahũa kũgirĩrĩria riũa ihiũ.

sentences.source: Pyrethrum thrives in well-drained, loamy volcanic soils with a pH of >5.6.
sentences.translation: Pyrethrum ĩciaraga wega ithaka-inĩ cia rĩera-inĩ na pH ya makĩria ma 5.6.
sentences.reference: Mahũa ma mbeniko makũraga wega tĩri-inĩ  ũikũrũkagia maĩ wega ũri na [cs] pH [cs]  ĩtagũkĩra ithano turuma ithathatũ.

sentences.source: Monitor market prices to determine the best time to sell coffee.
sentences.translation: Thuthuria thogora nĩguo ũmenye ihinda rĩrĩa rĩega rĩa kwendia cai.
sentences.reference: Thũgũnda mathogora nĩgetha ũmenye hĩndĩ ĩrĩa njega ya kwendia kahũa.

sentences.source: Maintain a soil pH between 5.5 and 6.5 for optimal coffee growth.
sentences.translation: Gũtũũria pH ya tĩĩri gatagatĩ ka 5.5 na 6.5 nĩguo kahua gakũre wega.
sentences.reference: Iga  gĩthimi gĩa tĩri kĩrĩ kĩa [cs] pH [cs] gatagatĩinĩ  ka ithano na nuthu nginya ithathatũ na nuthu nĩgetha kahũa gakũre wega

sentences.source: Monitor soil pH and adjust with lime or sulfur as needed.
sentences.translation: Thuthuria pH ya tĩĩri na ũhũthĩre lime kana sulphur kũringana na ũrĩa kũrabatarania.
sentences.reference: Rora ithimi  cia [cs] pH [cs] ya tĩri na ũigananie na  [sc] lime [cs] kana [cs] sulfur [cs]   ũria kũbataire.

sentences.source: Include pellets in their diet for essential nutrients.
sentences.translation: Reke magĩe na irio ta icio nĩguo magĩe na irio iria ciagĩrĩire.
sentences.reference: Ongerera tũirio twa mbũkũ irio-inĩ nĩguo kũongerera hinya mwĩrĩ.

sentences.source: Pyrethrum is a perennial crop -takes a period longer than two years without the need of being replanted each year
sentences.translation: Pyrethrum nĩ mũgũnda ũkoragwo na mĩmera mĩingĩ - ũkoragwo na ihinda rĩa makĩria ma mĩaka ĩĩrĩ ũtarĩ na bata wa kũhanda rĩngĩ o mwaka
sentences.reference: Mahũa ma mbeniko  nĩ mũmera  wa gũtũra  ũrĩa woyaga  kahinda ka makĩria ma mĩaka ĩrĩ  ũtakubatara kũhandwo rĩngĩ   mwaka o mwaka.

sentences.source: Pyrethrum requires a temperature of less than 18° C for at least 6 weeks
sentences.translation: Pyrethrum nĩ ĩbataraga ũrugarĩ wa thĩ ya 18° C kwa ihinda rĩa ciumia 6
sentences.reference: Mahũa ma mbeniko mabataraga mũigana wa ũrugarĩ  ũtakĩrĩtie [cs[ centigrade [cs] ikũmi na inyanya  gwa kahinda ka ciumia ithathatũ.

sentences.source: Separate sections for breeding and growing rabbits in the house.
sentences.translation: Icunjĩ itiganĩte cia kũrera na kũrera thenge thĩinĩ wa nyũmba.
sentences.reference: Gayania icunjĩ cia gũciarĩra  na  gũkũrĩra nyũmbainĩ ya mbũkũ.

sentences.source: Ensure compliance with coffee farming regulations and standards for quality assurance.
sentences.translation: Gũtigĩrĩra atĩ mawatho ma ũrĩmi wa kahũa na ithimi cia kũrũgamĩrĩra ũgima wa kahũa nĩ marũmagĩrĩrwo.
sentences.reference: Tĩgĩrĩra nĩ wahingia mawatho na mĩtaratara  ya ũrĩmi wa kahũa na ikĩro iria  ciandĩkithĩtio.

sentences.source: Fresh vegetables and leafy greens are good for rabbits.
sentences.translation: Mĩmera ĩrĩa njerũ na mĩmera ĩrĩa ĩrĩ mathangũ nĩ njega harĩ thenge.
sentences.reference: Mboga cia mũũkano na nyeni nĩ irio njega cia kũhe mbũkũ.

sentences.source: Keep a breeding schedule to maintain a steady supply of rabbits.
sentences.translation: Rũmagĩrĩra mũbango wa gũciaraga nĩguo ũkorũo na tũcui tũingĩ.
sentences.reference: Iga mũtaratara wa gũciarana kwa mbũkũ nĩgetha ũkoragwo na mbũkũ cia kwendia hĩndĩ ciothe.

sentences.source: Always check for signs of pests in the rabbit house.
sentences.translation: Hingo ciothe nĩ wagĩrĩirũo kũrora kana thĩinĩ wa kanyũmba ka thenge nĩ harĩ na tũnyamũ tũngĩ tũthũũkagia indo.
sentences.reference: Hingo ciothe rora kana  nyũmba ya mbũkũ ĩna tũnyamũ tũangangi.

sentences.source: Too much rain during harvest can cause wheat grains to sprout prematurely.
sentences.translation: Mbura nyingĩ mũno hĩndĩ ya magetha no itũme ngano ĩre na ihenya.
sentences.reference: Mbura nyingĩ  hĩndĩ ya kũgetha  no ĩtũme ngano ĩthethũke ihinda rĩtakinyĩte.

sentences.source: Use wire mesh and wood to build a durable rabbit house.
sentences.translation: Hũthĩra waya na mbaũ gwaka kanyũmba karaya ka thenge.
sentences.reference: Hũthĩra [cs] wire mesh[cs]  na mbaũ gũaka nyũmba  ĩngitũra ya gũikarwo nĩ mbũkũ.

sentences.source: Properly chill the meat immediately after slaughtering to preserve freshness.
sentences.translation: Nyama ĩcagĩrio na njĩra njega na ihenya thutha wa gũthĩnjwo nĩguo ĩtũũre ĩrĩ njerũ.
sentences.reference: Hehia nyama wega  warĩkia gũthĩnja  nĩguo  ũige nyama ĩyo ĩtagũthũka.

sentences.source: Thoroughly wash the rabbit carcass to remove any contaminants.
sentences.translation: Gũthambia kĩimba kĩa thenge wega nĩguo ũhote kweheria kĩndũ o gĩothe kĩngĩtũma gĩthũke.
sentences.reference: Thambia  mũrũndũrũndũ wa mbũkũ wega  nĩgetha ũrute gĩko gĩothe.

sentences.source: Bleed the rabbit properly after slaughtering for better meat quality.
sentences.translation: Thakame ya mbũri nĩ yagĩrĩirwo kũrutwo thutha wa gũthĩnjwo nĩguo nyama ĩgĩe na ũgima mwega.
sentences.reference: Ita thakame ya mbũku wega thutha wa gũthĩnja nĩguo ĩkorwo na nyama ya gĩkĩro kĩa igũrũ.

sentences.source: It has been a vital crop for human consumption for over 10,000 years.
sentences.translation: Ũkoroku ũkoretwo ũrĩ irio cia bata cia andũ kwa ihinda rĩa makĩria ma mĩaka 10,000.
sentences.reference: Ĩkoretwo irĩ ĩrio cia bata cia kũrĩo nĩ andũ gwa kahinda ka miaka ngiri ikũmi.

sentences.source: It is used to make bread, pasta, and various baked goods.
sentences.translation: Ĩhũthagĩrũo gũthondeka mũgate, pasta, na indo ingĩ cia kũruga.
sentences.reference: ĩhũthagirwo kuruga mĩgate, [cs] pasta [cs] na irio ingĩ cia kũruga mĩgate.

sentences.source: Obtain necessary permits and licenses for selling rabbit meat.
sentences.translation: Kũgĩa na marũa marĩa magĩrĩire ma kwendia nyama ya mbũri.
sentences.reference: Etha marũa na ritheni ma gũgũitĩkĩria kwendia nyama cia mbũkũ

sentences.source: Use humane trapping methods if you need to remove pests from the rabbit house.
sentences.translation: Hũthĩra njĩra itarĩ njũru cia kũiga mĩtego angĩkorũo nĩ ũrabatara kweheria nyamũ njũru nyũmba-inĩ ya thenge.
sentences.reference: Hũthĩra mĩtego ĩtari mĩrũrũ ya kweheria tũtambi nyũmbainĩ ya mbũkũ

sentences.source: Introduce new foods gradually to prevent digestive issues.
sentences.translation: Kũheana irio njerũ kahora kahora nĩ getha ũgirĩrĩrie mathĩna ma kũgaya irio.
sentences.reference: Ambĩrĩria kũhe mbũkũ irio ngeni kahora itikarũare nda

sentences.source: Use a sharp knife for quick and effective slaughter.
sentences.translation: Hũthĩra rũhiũ rũũgĩ nĩguo ũhote kũũraga na ihenya na njĩra njega.
sentences.reference: Hũthĩra kahiũ kogĩ gũthĩnja narua na njĩra njega

sentences.source: Start small with your rabbit farming and expand as you gain experience.
sentences.translation: Ambĩrĩria na tũnyamũ tũnini na ũthereme o ũrĩa ũgĩaga na ũmenyeru.
sentences.reference: Ambĩrĩria kahora ũrĩmi wa mbũkũ na waramie ũrĩmi wongerera ũgĩ

sentences.source: Attend farmers' markets to sell directly to consumers.
sentences.translation: Gũthiĩ thoko-inĩ cia arĩmi nĩguo makũre indo ciao na njĩra ya ĩmwe kwa ĩmwe.
sentences.reference: Ceraga thoko cia arĩmĩ nigetha wenderie agũri gũtari mĩhĩnga

sentences.source: Compost is often applied before wheat planting to improve soil fertility.
sentences.translation: Kaingĩ mũtararĩko ũhũthagĩrũo mbere ya kũhanda ngano nĩguo mũgũnda ũingĩhe.
sentences.reference: Thumu wa [cs] compost [cs] wĩkĩragwo ngano ĩkĩhandwo nĩgetha wongerere ũnoru wa tĩri.

sentences.source: Wheat is often grown in regions with moderate to low rainfall.
sentences.translation: Kaingĩ ngano ĩmenyagwo icigo-inĩ iria ikoragwo na mbura nini.
sentences.reference: Ngano ĩkũragio kũndũ kwĩ mbura njiganu nginya nini.

sentences.source: Proper sanitation reduces the risk of disease outbreaks.
sentences.translation: Gũtũũria mĩtaratara mĩega ya ũgima mwega wa mwĩrĩ nĩ gũteithagia kũniina ũgwati wa kũgĩa na mĩrimũ.
sentences.reference: Ũtheru ũrĩa wagĩrĩire  nĩũnyihagia ũgwati wa gũtuthũka kwa mĩrimũ

sentences.source: It is part of the Brassica family, like broccoli and kale.
sentences.translation: Ĩkoragwo thĩinĩ wa famĩlĩ ya Brassica, o ta broccoli na kale.
sentences.reference: Nĩ ya bamĩrĩ ya [cs] Brassica [cs]   ta [cs] broccoli [cs] na [cs] kale [cs].

sentences.source: Adequate rainfall at the flowering stage is crucial for grain development.
sentences.translation: Mbura ĩrĩa yagĩrĩire hĩndĩ ya mahũa nĩ ya bata mũno harĩ gũkũra kwa ngano.
sentences.reference: Mbura njiganu mahũa  makĩruta kiro nĩ ya bata nĩgetha mbegũ ikũre wega.

sentences.source: Pyrethrum is a perennial crop with a lifespan of up to 4 years.
sentences.translation: Pyrethrum nĩ mũthemba wa mĩmera ĩrĩa ĩciaraga mĩaka ĩna.
sentences.reference: Mahũa ma mbeniko nĩ mũmera wa gũikara mĩaka mĩingĩ mũgũnda na maikaraga kahinda ka mĩaka ĩna.

sentences.source: Regularly check the rabbit house for signs of wear and tear.
sentences.translation: Thiĩ na mbere gũthuthuria kabati ĩyo nĩguo wone kana nĩ ĩthararĩte.
sentences.reference: Roraga kaingĩ kĩonania gĩa gũthũka  kwa nyũmba ya mbũkũ.

sentences.source: Plough and apply herbicides about 2 weeks before planting.
sentences.translation: Wĩthambe na ũhũthĩre ndawa cia kũniina mĩmera ta ciumia igĩrĩ mbere ya kũhanda.
sentences.reference: Rĩma na ũhuhĩre ndawa ciumia ta  igirĩ ũtanahanda

sentences.source: Proper hygiene is essential during the slaughtering process.
sentences.translation: Ũgima mwega wa mwĩrĩ nĩ wa bata hĩndĩ ya gũthĩnjwo.
sentences.reference: Ũtheru mwega nĩ wa bata mũno hĩndĩ  ya gũthĩnja.

sentences.source: Consistent moisture from rainfall or irrigation is important for cabbage.
sentences.translation: Kũgĩa na ũrugarĩ hĩndĩ ciothe nĩ ũndũ wa mbura kana wa kũnoria nĩ ũndũ wa bata harĩ kabici.
sentences.reference: Ũgunyu ũrehetwo nĩ  mbura kana uunĩthĩria wa maĩ  nĩ ũrĩ bata ũkūria-inĩ wa   kabici.

sentences.source: Accurate fertilizer application rates are dependent on results from the soil analysis.
sentences.translation: Mũigana ũrĩa ũhũthĩkaga wa mboga ũkoragwo wĩhocetie harĩ moimĩrĩro ma gũthuthuria mũgũnda.
sentences.reference: Gĩkĩro kĩringanu wega  kĩa bataraitha iria ĩkũhũthĩrwo  ĩbatie kuumana na maumĩrĩra na ũrĩa tĩrĩ ũthuthurĩtwo.

sentences.source: Cabbage is widely grown across the world for its nutritional value.
sentences.translation: Mũkaraka ũmenyagĩrũo mũno thĩinĩ wa thĩ yothe nĩ ũndũ wa ũguni ũrĩa ũrĩ naguo harĩ irio.
sentences.reference: Kabici ĩkũragio kũndũ kũingĩ  mũno thĩ nĩũndũ wa bata mwĩrĩ-inĩ.

sentences.source: Build relationships with local markets and restaurants for regular sales.
sentences.translation: Gĩa na ũkuruhanu na thoko cia kũu na maresitora nĩguo ũhote kwendia na njĩra ya mũbango.
sentences.reference: Tũma ngwatanĩro na thoko cia gũkũ na mĩkawa  nĩgetha  na wendagie hĩndĩ o hĩndĩ.

sentences.source: Frost during flowering can destroy wheat heads.
sentences.translation: Kĩhuhũkanio hĩndĩ ya mahũa no gĩthũkie mahũa ma ngano.
sentences.reference: Heho nyĩngĩ no ĩthũkie ngano rĩrĩa ĩraruta kĩro.

sentences.source: This includes temperature and rainfall requirements
sentences.translation: Ũndũ ũcio nĩ ũhutĩtie maũndũ megiĩ ũrugarĩ na mbura
sentences.reference: Ũndũ ũyũ nĩ hamwe na mabataro ma ũrugarĩ na mbura.

sentences.source: Loamy soils rich in organic matter are ideal for wheat farming.
sentences.translation: Mĩgũnda ya rĩũmba ĩrĩ na indo nyingĩ cia kĩĩmwĩrĩ nĩ njega mũno harĩ kũrĩma ngano.
sentences.reference: Tĩri wa kĩhukuhuku mũnoru nĩ mwega wa kũhanda ngano.

sentences.source: Pyrethrum plants should be cut back once a year.
sentences.translation: Mĩmera ya pyrethrum yagĩrĩirũo kũng'ethwo o mwaka.
sentences.reference: Mahũa ma mbeniko mabatie gũcehwo  rita rĩmwe o mwaka.

sentences.source: Altitude affects the length of the wheat growing season.
sentences.translation: Ũraihu nĩ ũhutagia ũraihu wa hĩndĩ ya gũkũra kwa ngano.
sentences.reference: Ũraihu wa igũrũ na thĩ nĩ  ũhutagia kahinda ga kĩmera gĩa gũkũria ngano.

sentences.source: heavy frost, which can occur at high altitudes, causes reduction in yield
sentences.translation: ng'aragu nene, ĩrĩa ĩngĩoneka kũndũ kũrĩa kũraihu mũno, nĩ ĩnyihanyihia magetha
sentences.reference: Heho nyĩngĩ mũno  irĩmainĩ no inyihie maciaro.

sentences.source: in order to initiate flowering.
sentences.translation: nĩguo kĩambĩrĩrie kũgaacĩra.
sentences.reference: nĩgetha mahote kũruta kĩro.

sentences.source: For better drying farmers are advised to use a solar dryer.
sentences.translation: Arĩmi nĩ magĩrĩirũo kũhũthĩra macini ya kũniina indo na thitima ya kũniina indo na thitima ya riũa.
sentences.reference: Nĩgeetha kũmithia wega arĩmĩ mataragwo mahũthire hinya wa thitima ya riũa.

sentences.source: It grows to a height of approximately one meter.
sentences.translation: Ũraihu wa mũtĩ ũcio no ta mita ĩmwe.
sentences.reference: Ĩkũraga ta   hakuhĩ ũraihu  wa mita ĩmwe.

sentences.source: Fertilizers are usually applied in two doses: at planting and during growth.
sentences.translation: Kaingĩ mĩmera ĩhũthagĩrũo maita merĩ: hĩndĩ ya kũhanda na hĩndĩ ya gũkũra.
sentences.reference: Bataraitha kaingĩ ĩkĩragwo maita merĩ, hĩndĩ ya kũhanda na hĩndĩ ya  mĩmera ĩgĩkũra.

sentences.source: Wheat grows best in well-drained, fertile soils.
sentences.translation: Ng'ano ikũraga wega mũno tĩri-inĩ mũrũngarũ na ũrĩ na maĩ maingĩ.
sentences.reference: Ngano ĩkũraga wega tĩri-inĩ mũnoru na  ũikũrũkagia maĩ wega.

sentences.source: Early planting allows wheat to establish roots before cold weather
sentences.translation: Kũhanda na ihenya nĩ gũteithagia ngano ĩgĩe na mĩri mbere ya ihinda rĩa heho
sentences.reference: Kũhanda tene nĩ gũteithagia mĩri ya ngano  kũambĩka  gũtanagĩa heho.

sentences.source: Sun drying is the most common method.
sentences.translation: Kũhũa riũa nĩguo njĩra ĩrĩa hũthagĩrũo mũno.
sentences.reference: Kũmithia na riũa nĩyo  njĩra ĩrĩa ĩhũthĩkaga mũno.

sentences.source: Wheat yields may decline at very high altitudes due to cold.
sentences.translation: Mũcaayo wa ngano no ũnyihanyihe kũndũ kũrĩa kũraihu mũno nĩ ũndũ wa heho.
sentences.reference: Maciaro ma ngano no manyihe kũndũ kwĩ  ũraihu wa igũrũ nĩũndũ wa heho.

sentences.source: There are different types of wheat, including hard, soft,
sentences.translation: Gũkoragwo na mĩthemba mĩingĩ ya ngano, ta ĩrĩa njiganu, ĩrĩa nyoroku,
sentences.reference: Nĩ kũrĩ  mĩthemba ngũrani ya ngano hamwe na ĩrĩa  nyũmū na njororo.

sentences.source: Flowers should be harvested at the correct bud stage
sentences.translation: Mĩmera nĩ yagĩrĩirũo kũgethwo hĩndĩ ĩrĩa ĩrĩ mĩmera
sentences.reference: Mahũa mabatiĩ gũtuo marĩkia gūthethuka wega.

sentences.source: Control pests to protect wheat from damage.
sentences.translation: Kũniina tũnyamũ tũrĩa tũthũkagia mĩgũnda nĩguo tũgitĩre ngano.
sentences.reference: Gitĩra ngano ndĩgathūke nĩ kugirĩrĩria tūtambĩ.

sentences.source: Flowers should not be picked under rainy conditions.
sentences.translation: Maciara matiagĩrĩirũo kũrutwo hĩndĩ ya mbura.
sentences.reference: Mahũa matibatie gũtuo  mbura ĩkiura.

sentences.source: Overripe wheat can shatter, causing grain loss during harvest.
sentences.translation: Ngano iria ciakũrĩte mũno no ithũke, na ũndũ ũcio ũgatũma mbegũ ciũre hĩndĩ ya magetha.
sentences.reference: Ngano yakūra  mūno  no  ĩhehenjeke na ĩnyihie  magetha.

sentences.source: Plant the seeds at a depth of 2 to 3 centimeters.
sentences.translation: Handa mbegũ icio na ũraihu wa sentimita 2 nginya 3.
sentences.reference: Handa mbegũ ũrikũ wa [cs] centimetre [cs]  igĩrĩ nginya ithatũ.

sentences.source: Wheat can be grown in lowland and highland regions.
sentences.translation: Ng'ano no ikũragwo icigo-inĩ iria irĩ kũndũ kũraihu na irĩ irĩma-inĩ.
sentences.reference: Ngano nũĩkũrio mĩgunda-inĩ  kũndũ kũrĩ ĩgũrũ kana kũrĩ  thĩ.

sentences.source: Irrigation can supplement rainfall during dry periods.
sentences.translation: Gũitĩrĩria maĩ maĩ-inĩ no gũteithie mbura ihinda-inĩ rĩrĩa kũrĩ na ng'aragu.
sentences.reference: Unithĩria wa maĩ no ũteithĩrĩrie hĩndĩ ya riũa.

sentences.source: High temperatures during grain filling can reduce wheat yields.
sentences.translation: Rĩera rĩrĩ na ũrugarĩ mũingĩ hĩndĩ ya kũhũũra ngano no rĩnyihie magetha ma ngano.
sentences.reference: Ũrugarĩ mũingĩ hĩndĩ ya kũgetha no ũnyihie maciaro.

sentences.source: Timing is crucial to prevent losses during wheat harvest.
sentences.translation: Nĩ ũndũ wa bata kũhũthĩra ihinda rĩrĩa rĩagĩrĩire nĩguo tũtigathũkio hĩndĩ ya magetha ma ngano.
sentences.reference: Kwamũra ihinda rĩagĩrĩru rĩa kũgetha ngano nĩ kũgiragĩrĩria hathara.

sentences.source: Consistent moisture levels help improve wheat yields.
sentences.translation: Kũgĩa na ũrugarĩ mũingĩ nĩ gũteithagia ngano kũgĩa na magetha maingĩ.
sentences.reference: Ũgunyu ũrĩa wagĩrĩire nĩũteithagĩrĩria kũagagĩria  maciaro ma ngano.

sentences.source: The best time to plant wheat depends on the local climate.
sentences.translation: Hĩndĩ ĩrĩa njagĩrĩru ya kũhanda ngano ĩhocetie harĩ rĩera rĩa kũrĩa ũikaraga.
sentences.reference: Ihinda rĩega rĩa kũhanda ngano rĩhocanagia  na rĩera rĩa kũndũ kũu

sentences.source: Wheat storage facilities are designed to prevent contamination.
sentences.translation: Nyũmba cia kũiga ngano ikoragwo ithondeketwo na njĩra ĩgũthiĩ na mbere kũgitĩra ngano ĩyo ndĩthũke.
sentences.reference: Makũmbi ma kũiga ngano mathondeketwo magirĩrĩrie ũthũkia wa ngano na gĩko.

sentences.source: Cold temperatures can damage wheat seedlings .
sentences.translation: Rĩera rĩa heho no rĩthũkie mĩmera ya ngano.
sentences.reference: Heho no ĩthũkie mĩmera ya ngano.

sentences.source: Farmers use seed drills to plant wheat more accurately.
sentences.translation: Arĩmi mahũthagĩra macini cia kũhanda mbeũ nĩguo mahinge ngano wega.
sentences.reference: Arĩmĩ mahũthagĩra macini ya mbegũ nĩgũo kũhanda  ngano ũrĩa  kũagĩrĩire.

sentences.source: Fumigation is used to protect stored wheat from insect infestations.
sentences.translation: Kũhũra mũtu nĩ kũhũthagĩrũo kũgitĩra ngano ĩrĩa ĩigĩtwo mĩgũnda-inĩ ndĩthũkio nĩ tũnyamũ.
sentences.reference: Ndawa nĩhũraguo kũgirĩrĩria ngano makũmbĩ-inĩ  gũthũkio nĩ tũnyamu tũnini.

sentences.source: It is a low-calorie vegetable with high fiber content.
sentences.translation: Nĩ irio itarĩ na calorie nyingĩ na irĩ na fibre nyingĩ.
sentences.reference: Nĩ mboga ĩtarĩ hinya mũingĩ na tũmatanda tũingĩ.

sentences.source: There are different types of cabbage, including green, red, and Savoy.
sentences.translation: Nĩ kũrĩ mĩthemba ĩtiganĩte ya cabi, ta cabi njerũ, cabi ndune, na cabi ya Savoy.
sentences.reference: Nĩ kũrĩ  mĩthemba mĩingĩ ya kabici ĩrĩa nĩ hamwe na kabici ya rangi wa nyeki nduru, rangi mũtune  na kabici ya [cs] savoy [cs].

sentences.source: Herbicides help control weeds that compete with wheat for nutrients.
sentences.translation: Mĩmera ya kũniina nyeki nĩ ĩteithagia kũniina itindiĩ iria irũaga na ngano nĩ ũndũ wa irio.
sentences.reference: Ndawa ya kũhuhĩra kũgirĩrĩria ria kũhĩtahĩtanĩra irio na ngano.

sentences.source: Wheat is often stored in bulk to supply markets throughout the year.
sentences.translation: Kaingĩ ngano ĩigagwo ĩrĩ mĩingĩ nĩ getha ĩhingĩrie thoko mwaka wothe.
sentences.reference: Kaingĩ ngano nyingĩ  ĩigagwo nĩgetha ĩkahota kwendio thokoinĩ  mwaka wothe.

sentences.source: It grows best in cool temperatures between 15°C and 20°C.
sentences.translation: Ĩkũraga wega mũno kũrĩa kũrĩ na ũrugarĩ wa gatagatĩ ka 15°C na 20°C.
sentences.reference: Ikũraga wega kũndũ kũruru kũri na ũrugarĩ wa [cs[degrees centigrade  [cs] ikũmi na ithano na [cs] degrees centigrade  [cs] mĩrongo ĩrĩ.

sentences.source: fields are monitored for fungal diseases like rust and mildew.
sentences.translation: mĩgũnda nĩ ĩroragwo nĩ ũndũ wa mĩrimũ ya mĩmera ta rũũa na ngigĩ.
sentences.reference: Mũgũnda ũroragwo nĩgetha kweheria mĩrimũ ta [cs] rust [cs] na [cs] mildew[cs].

sentences.source: Organic matter improves soil structure and water retention for wheat crops.
sentences.translation: Indo iria ithondeketwo na njĩra ya ndũire nĩ iteithagia mũgũnda kũhanda wega na kũiga maaĩ thĩinĩ wa mĩgũnda ya ngano.
sentences.reference: ũbũthu tĩrinĩ ũteihagia gũthondeka mũmbire wa tĩri na ũhoti wa tĩri kũiga maũ.

sentences.source: Wheat stalks are cut, and the grain is separated using threshers.
sentences.translation: Mĩgogo ya ngano nĩ ĩgethagwo, na ngano ĩgethagwo na kĩng'ang'i.
sentences.reference: Mĩkori ya ngano ya ĩrengagwo na ngano ĩgathandũrwo kũhũthĩra [cs] threshers [cs].

sentences.source: If you’re growing your own fodder you’ll need about 1 acre per year to feed one cow, one heifer and a calf.
sentences.translation: Ũngĩkũria irio ciaku we mwene ũbataire acre 1 o mwaka nĩguo ũheage ng'ombe ĩmwe, ndũrũme ĩmwe na gacaũ irio.
sentences.reference: Angĩkorwo nĩwe ũrĩrĩmĩra irio cia mahiũ, ũkũbatara ĩka ĩmwe o mwaka, kũrĩithia ng'ombe ĩmwe, mori na njaũ.

sentences.source: This way, you’ll have enough good fodder for your cows even when it gets dry and milk prices go up.
sentences.translation: Na njĩra ĩyo, nĩ ũgakorũo na irio cia kũigana cia ng'ombe ciaku o na rĩrĩa rĩera rĩgũthira na thogora wa iria wongerereke.
sentences.reference: Njĩra ĩno ĩgũtũma ũiganie irio cia ng'ombe ciaku nginya riũa rĩara na thogora wa iria wa haica

sentences.source: The Coast and a few parts of the Highlands East of the Rift Valley received near to below average rainfall.
sentences.translation: Iria-inĩ rĩu na icigo cigana ũna cia irĩma iria irĩ mwena wa irathĩro wa Rift Valley gũkoretwo na mbura nyingĩ gũkĩra ũrĩa kwahoteka.
sentences.reference: Gĩcũa-inĩ na icigo nini cia irĩma-inĩ cia irathĩro rĩa [cs] Rift Valley [cs] nĩ ciagĩire mbura niini ĩtaiganire

sentences.source: Packaging protects the eggs from bacteria, natural predator, loss of moisture, temperatures that cause deterioration and crushing.
sentences.translation: Gũthondekwo kũgitagĩra matumbĩ matigathũkio nĩ bakteria, nyamũ cia gĩthaka, matigathũkio nĩ ũrugarĩ, na matigathũkio nĩ ũrugarĩ ũrĩa ũngĩtũma mathũke na mathũke.
sentences.reference: Kũiga matumbĩ wega nĩ kũgiragĩrĩria mathuke na [cs] bacteria[cs], kwaga kũrĩo nĩ nyamũ, na gũte rĩera, na ũrugarĩ mũingĩ na gũkua.

sentences.source: The soil on the upper side slows the run off water and lets it sink into the soil and stops soil being washed away.
sentences.translation: Gĩthaka kĩrĩa kĩrĩ mwena wa igũrũ nĩ kĩgiragia maĩ mathiĩ na ihenya na gĩgatũma maĩ mahurunjũke thĩinĩ wa tĩĩri na kĩgirĩrĩrie tĩĩri ndũkahurunjũke.
sentences.reference: tĩri wa mwena wa naigũrũ nĩ ũgiragĩrĩria maĩ gũikũrũka mĩtũkĩ na kũrika thĩ na kũgiria tĩri gũtwarwo.

sentences.source: Bio-slurry/digestate when used as a fertilizer enhances physical, chemical, and biological attributes of the soil and increases crop productivity when applied to the land
sentences.translation: Bio-slurry/digestate rĩrĩa ĩhũthĩrĩtwo ĩrĩ fertilizer nĩ ĩongagĩrĩria physical, chemical, na biological attributes cia tĩĩri na ĩgakũra magetha ma mĩmera rĩrĩa ĩhũthĩrĩtwo mũgũnda-inĩ
sentences.reference: gĩko kĩa [cs]Bio-slurry [cs] [cs]digestate[cs] gĩatũmĩka ta thumu nĩkĩrombũiyagia ũgima mwega wa tĩri na kwongerera maciaro.

sentences.source: Young trees need no pruning during the first 2 - 3 years.
sentences.translation: Mĩaka ĩĩrĩ kana ĩtatũ ya mbere, mĩtĩ ĩyo ndĩbataraga gũtuwo.
sentences.reference: Mĩtĩ mĩnini ndĩendaga gũcehwo mbere ya miaka ĩrĩ nginya ĩtatũ.

sentences.source: Biogas improves health of rural low-income households by providing a cleaner cooking fuel and a waste handling solution thus avoiding health problems
sentences.translation: Biogas nĩ ĩteithagia mĩciĩ ĩrĩa ĩtarĩ na mbeca nyingĩ mĩgũnda-inĩ na njĩra ya kũheana maguta matheru ma kũruga na njĩra ya gwĩthema mathĩna ma ũgima wa mwĩrĩ
sentences.reference: [cs] Biogas [cs] nĩ ĩteithagĩa aikari a niini a maturaĩnĩ, nĩ iteithagia kũmahe mwaki ũtarĩ ndogo wa kũruga, nĩũndũ wa kũmenyerera ũgĩma wa mwĩrĩ.

sentences.source: Good housing should protect the birds from extreme weather and predators.
sentences.translation: Mĩciĩ mĩega yagĩrĩirũo nĩ kũgitĩra nyoni icio itikanyitwo nĩ maũndũ moru ma rĩera na itikanyitwo nĩ nyamũ njũru.
sentences.reference: Nyũmba cia ngũkũ njega nĩ ĩbatie kũgitĩra tũcui kumana na rĩera rĩuru na nyamũ.

sentences.source: Social development due to the reduced workload from women and children associated with collecting fuelwood or cow dung and also the availability of clean household energy.
sentences.translation: Ũgarũrũku wa mĩikarĩre ya andũ nĩ ũndũ wa kũniinwo kwa wĩra wa atumia na ciana ũrĩa ũrutagwo na gũcokanĩrĩria ngũ kana mũhu wa ng'ombe na ningĩ nĩ ũndũ wa kũgĩa na hinya mũtheru wa kũruta wĩra mĩciĩ-inĩ.
sentences.reference: ũthii wa na mbere nĩũndũ wa kũnyihia wĩra mũĩngĩ wa atumia na ciana ũkuruhanĩtĩ na kuuna ngũ kana mai ma ng'ombe hamwe na mwaki ũtari ndogo.

sentences.source: Improved groundnut varieties available in Kenya include KEN-GNUT 1, Egerton GN-1 (L), Egerton GN- 2 (R), Gathuku, Lihanga and Kanga.
sentences.translation: Mĩhĩrĩga ya groundnut ĩrĩa ĩhũthĩkaga Kenya nĩ ta KEN-GNUT 1, Egerton GN-1 (L), Egerton GN-2 (R), Gathuku, Lihanga na Kanga.
sentences.reference: Mũthemba wa njũgũ karanga wagĩritio Kenya nĩ: [cs]KEN-GNUT 1[cs], [cs] Egerton GN-1 (L) [cs], [cs]Egerton GN- 2 (R) [cs], [cs]Gathuku [cs], [cs] Lihanga [cs] na [cs] Kanga [cs].

sentences.source: Plant young cocoa seedlings from your own nursery, or buy from a research centre.
sentences.translation: Ũrĩma tũtheri tũnini twa cacao kuuma mũgũnda-inĩ waku, kana ũgũre kuuma kũrĩ kambuni ya ũthuthuria.
sentences.reference: Handa mĩmera mĩnini ya [cs] cocoa [cs] kuuma nathari yaku, kana ũgũre rũhongeinĩ rwa ũthuthuria wa mĩmera

sentences.source: Bole rot causes a wet rot which becomes yellowish-brown and soft, which may lead to the plant collapsing and dying.
sentences.translation: Kũbutha nĩ gũtũmaga mũtĩ ũbuthe ũtuĩke wa rangi wa macungwa na ũtuĩke mũhũthũ, na ũndũ ũcio no ũtũme mũtĩ ũbuthe na ũkue.
sentences.reference: mũrĩmũ wa [cs] Bole rot [cs] ũtũmaga [cs] wet rot [cs] ũtuĩkaga rangi wa ngoikoni ũtukanĩte na wa gĩtĩri na mũtuĩku, no ũtũme mũmera wage kũgwata.

sentences.source: Plant cocoa trees at the start of the rainy season.
sentences.translation: Handaga mĩtĩ ya cacao kĩambĩrĩria-inĩ kĩa hĩndĩ ya mbura.
sentences.reference: Handa mĩti ya [cs] cocoa [cs] kĩmera kĩa mbura gĩkĩambĩrĩria.

sentences.source: A vaccination program should be shared when day old chicks are purchased.
sentences.translation: Mũbango wa kũhe tũcui mĩrimũ nĩ wagĩrĩirũo kũmenyithanio rĩrĩa tũgũragwo tũcui twa mũthenya ũmwe.
sentences.reference: Mũbango wa njanjo nĩ ũbatie kũmenyithanio rĩrĩ tũcui twa ũkũrũ wa mũthenya ũmwe twagũrwo.

sentences.source: Only ripe leaves should be harvested.
sentences.translation: Nĩ mathangũ marĩa marĩkĩtie gũthundũka me wiki magĩrĩirwo nĩ kũgethwo.
sentences.reference: Mathangũ meru nimũ mabatie gũtuo.

sentences.source: Plant cover crops between the sisal rows during the first 3 years to keep the land weed-free.
sentences.translation: Mĩmera ya kũhumbĩra mĩmera gatagatĩ-inĩ ka mĩtĩ ya sisal mĩaka ĩtatũ ya mbere nĩguo mũgũnda ndũgakorũo na mĩmera mĩũru.
sentences.reference: Handa mĩmera ya kũhumbĩra tĩri gatagatĩ ga mĩtaro ya makongo miaka itatũ ya mbere nĩgetha kweheria ria mũgũndainĩ.

sentences.source: The fruits harvested increases as the tree continues to grow.
sentences.translation: O ũrĩa mũtĩ ũrakũra, noguo maciaro maguo marongerereka.
sentences.reference: Matunda magethetwo nĩmongagĩrĩrĩka o ũrĩa mũtĩ ũrathĩ mbere na gũkũra.

sentences.source: Groundnuts are mature when 70-80% of the inside of the pods shells have dark markings and the kernels are plump, with colour characteristic of that variety.
sentences.translation: Mũgũnda wa mbegũ ũkoragwo wĩ mũrũngarũ rĩrĩa gĩcunjĩ kĩa 70-80% kĩa mathangũ ma mũgũnda ũcio makoragwo na marũũri ma nduma, namo mathangũ ma mũgũnda ũcio makorũo marĩ matune na makorũo na marangi ma mũgũnda ũcio.
sentences.reference: Njũgũ Karanga ĩkoragũo ĩ ngũrũ hĩndĩ ĩrĩa thĩinĩ wa makoro ĩna ũirũ gĩcũnjĩ kĩa mĩrongo mũgwanja nginya mĩrongo ĩnana harĩ igana na rangi ya mũthemba ũcio.

sentences.source: Diseases that affect rice include Bacteria leaf blight.
sentences.translation: Mĩrimũ ĩrĩa yonanagia mũtu nĩ ta mũrimũ wa Bacteria leaf blight.
sentences.reference: Mĩrĩmũ ĩrĩa ĩnyitaga mũcere nĩta ĩkoragwo hamwe na [cs]bacteria[/cs] [cs] leaf [/cs] [cs] blight [/cs]

sentences.source: Transplant avocado about 20 days after germination.
sentences.translation: Handa mbegũ ya avocado ta thikũ 20 thutha wa kũmera.
sentences.reference: Thamia mũkondobia ta thikũ mĩrongo ĩrĩ thutha wa mbegũ gũthethũka.

sentences.source: The cartons should be well ventilated.
sentences.translation: Maboketi macio magĩrĩirũo gũkorũo marĩ na rĩera rĩega.
sentences.reference: Makatoni mabatie kũingĩria riera wega.

sentences.source: Control wheat diseases e.g leaf rust by planting resistant varieties, control weeds
sentences.translation: Kũhũrana na mĩrimũ ya ngano na njĩra ya kũrĩma mĩmera ĩngĩhota kũhũrana na mĩrimũ ĩyo na njĩra ya kũhanda mĩmera ĩngĩhota kũhũrana na mĩmera ĩyo
sentences.reference: Ramata mĩrimũ ya ngano ta [cs] leaf [cs][cs] rust[cs] na kũhanda mĩthemba ya ngano ĩtanyitagwo nĩ mĩrimũ

sentences.source: Choose cowpea seeds with high germination rate, not insect damaged or broken
sentences.translation: Thuura mbegũ cia ng'ombe irĩ na ũhoti mũnene wa kũmbũka, itarĩ na mahĩtia ma tũnyamũ
sentences.reference: Thura mbegũ cia thoroko ĩrĩa imeraga narua, na ĩtathũkĩtio nĩ tũtambĩ kana kunekanga

sentences.source: Before storage, mix seed with a mixture of pesticidal plant parts (e.g.neem, lantana).
sentences.translation: Mbere ya kũiga mbegũ, ĩtukanĩrio na mũtukanio wa mĩmera ĩrĩa ĩhũthagĩra ndawa cia kũniina mĩrimũ (n.g.neem, lantana).
sentences.reference: Ũtanaiga mbegũ thitoo, tũkania mbegũ na dawa cia tũtambĩ ta [cs] neem [cs], [cs] lantana [cs]

sentences.source: At flowering, temperatures should not exceed 30°C
sentences.translation: Hĩndĩ ya kũgaacĩra, rĩera rĩtiagĩrĩirũo gũkorũo na ũrugarĩ mũnene gũkĩra 30°C
sentences.reference: Ĩkĩruta kĩro, ũrugarĩ ndũgakĩre [cs] centigrade [cs] mĩrongo ĩtatũ

sentences.source: Other varieties include Kat-Kunde, Kunde Faulu, Kunde Tumaini, M66, KVU 27-1, and K80
sentences.translation: Mĩhĩrĩga ĩngĩ nĩ ta Kat-Kunde, Kunde Faulu, Kunde Tumaini, M66, KVU 27-1, na K80
sentences.reference: Mĩthemba ĩngi nĩ ta [cs]Kat-Kunde[cs], [cs]Kunde Fauu[cs], [cs]Kunde Tumaini[cs], [cs]M66[cs], [cs]KVU 27-1[cs], na [cs]K80[cs]

sentences.source: The common Cowpea varieties in Kenya are: Kunde Tamu, Kunde Soko.
sentences.translation: Mĩmera ĩrĩa mĩingĩ mũno Kenya nĩ: Kunde Tamu, Kunde Soko.
sentences.reference: Mĩthemba ya thoroko ĩrĩa yonekaga kaĩngĩ Kenya nĩ [cs]Kunde Tamu[cs], [cs]Kunde Soko[cs]

sentences.source: Do winnowing to separate clean wheat grains from the chaff,
sentences.translation: Gũthambia nĩguo ũtigithanie ngano ĩrĩa njega na makũnia,
sentences.reference: Huha na gĩtarũrũ kũeheranĩria ngano theru na mahutii

sentences.source: Take necessary action to reduce damage as recommended by agricultural experts
sentences.translation: Kuoya makinya marĩa magĩrĩire kũniina hathara ta ũrĩa athomi a maũndũ ma ũrĩmi meendaga
sentences.reference: Hiũha gũtabarĩrĩa maũndũ nigetha ũnyihie gũthũkangia ũria wendekithĩtio nĩ abithaa wa ngirigacha

sentences.source: Do a germination test 10 days before planting cowpeas
sentences.translation: Gwĩka kĩgeranio kĩa mĩmera matukũ ikũmi mbere ya kũhanda mbegũ cia ng'ombe
sentences.reference: Geria kũmerithia thoroko thikũ ikũmi mbere ya kũhanda

sentences.source: Put clean grain in 90 kg bags.
sentences.translation: Ikia ngano njerũ magomano-inĩ ma kilo 90.
sentences.reference: Ĩkĩra ngano theru makũniainĩ ma kio mĩrongo kenda

sentences.source: Cover crops manage soil fertility, soil quality, water, pests, and diseases.
sentences.translation: Mĩmera ĩrĩa ĩhũthagĩrũo kũhumbĩra mũgũnda nĩ ĩteithagia kũiga mũgũnda mwega, kũiga maaĩ mega, kũgirĩrĩria tũnyamũ tũrĩa tũthũkagia mĩmera, na kũgirĩrĩria mĩrimũ.
sentences.reference: Mĩmera ya kũhumbĩra tĩri ĩthingataga ũnoru wa tĩri, maĩ, kũramata tũtambĩ na mĩrimũ

sentences.source: Cowpea is the second most important legume crop after common beans in Kenya
sentences.translation: Mbeũ ya cowpea nĩyo mbeũ ya kerĩ ya bata mũno bũrũri-inĩ wa Kenya thutha wa ngũyũ
sentences.reference: Thoroko nĩyo ya kerĩ ĩrĩ bata mũno bũrũrinĩ wa Kenya kũrũmĩrĩra mboco

sentences.source: Sow the kale seeds and cover lightly with soil.
sentences.translation: Handa mbegũ icio na ũhumbĩre na tĩĩri.
sentences.reference: Hura mbegũ cia matharũ na ũhumbĩre hanini na tĩri

sentences.source: Common kale varieties include collards, marrow stem and Thousand Headed are the most common varieties
sentences.translation: Mbegũ iria ikoragwo mũno nĩ ta collards, marrow stem na Thousand Headed
sentences.reference: Mĩthemba ya matharũ ĩrĩa yonekaga mũno ni [cs]collards[cs], [cs]marrow stem[cs] na [cs]thousand headed[cs].

sentences.source: Start hardening the seedlings 1 – 2 weeks before transplanting.
sentences.translation: Kĩambĩrĩria gĩa kũũmia mĩmera nĩ kiumia kĩmwe kana igĩrĩ mbere ya kũhandwo.
sentences.reference: Ambĩrĩra kũmithia mbegũ kiumia kĩmwe nginya igĩrĩ ũtanahanda

sentences.source: Afterwards water the cloth 3 times a day, examine the seeds on the 3rd day.
sentences.translation: Thuutha wa ũguo, nyunje nguo ĩyo maita matatũ o mũthenya, ũcoke ũthuthurie mbeũ ĩyo mũthenya wa gatatũ.
sentences.reference: Warĩkia kũhanda, itĩrĩria gĩtambaya maĩ maita matatũ o mũthenya, na uthũrime mbegũ icio mũthenya wa gatatũ

sentences.source: Use certified kale seed with special attributes

sentences.reference: Ũria kũronekana nĩ atĩ kũngĩthiĩ na mbere kwara riũa inene  no kwage kũgethwo mbembe Kaunti ya Nyeri

sentences.source: In the Nyanza region, more than 70% of the maize is at the vegetative and tasseling stage.
sentences.translation: Thĩinĩ wa gĩcigo kĩa Nyanza, makĩria ma gĩcunjĩ kĩa 70 harĩ igana kĩa mũgũnda wa mbembe wĩ mũgũnda-inĩ wa mĩmera.
sentences.reference: Gĩcigoinĩ kĩa Nyanza, makĩria ma gĩcunjĩ kĩa mĩrongo mũgwaja harĩ igana nĩ hĩndĩ mbembe ĩrakũra na kũruta kĩmira

sentences.source: Rice is in favourable condition in Kirinyaga.
sentences.translation: Mĩtĩ ya mũtu nĩ mĩega mũno thĩinĩ wa Kirinyaga.
sentences.reference: Mũcere nĩwagagĩrĩrwo nĩ rĩera Kirinyaga.

sentences.source: In Murangâ_x0080__x0099_a, Kirinyaga and Kiambu land is under preparation.

sentences.reference: Mĩgũnda nĩ ĩraharĩrio Mũranga, Kirinyaga, na Kĩambu

sentences.source: Maize and beans performance are expected to be normal due to the good performance of the short rains in the region.
sentences.translation: Ũrĩmi wa mbembe na mboco nĩ ũretereirwo kũgĩa na maciaro mega nĩ ũndũ wa mbura nini iria ciaiyũire gĩcigo-inĩ kĩu.

sentences.source: Quelea quelea birds menace is being addressed through bird scaring and aerial spraying of pesticides.
